headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red while Nifty gained 75 points; smallcaps and Paytm remained in focus.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Sensex slipped into red following the CAS announcement in the last session.
Nifty managed to gain 75 points despite volatility in the broader market.
Crypto-related stocks tumbled 10% due to setbacks in the CLARITY Act.
Concerns over potential additional U.S. tariffs expressed by CITI weighed on sentiment.
whatHappening: Smallcap stocks showed mixed performance as the market outlook remains cautious.
Traders in Ghaziabad announced a shift to cash-only transactions over UPI MDR concerns.
India and New Zealand are nearing the implementation of a significant Free Trade Agreement.
Investors are closely monitoring crude oil prices and FII activity for the upcoming week.

stocksInNews.sources: CITI expresses concern over potential additional tariffs

summary: The Indian market saw a mixed performance in the last session with Nifty gaining 75 points while Sensex ended in the red. Investors are reacting to UPI MDR concerns and global trade developments like the India-NZ FTA. Markets remain closed for the weekend and will resume on Tuesday.
